criteria.criterion: docs/domain/domain-model.md has, under "Plans and tasks", P-8 with the brief's wording: A gate judges the brief's contract from outside the work: it never runs the repository's suite, a check, or a test a task writes. The checks run the tests (P-7). Every acceptance criterion is judged by its task's gate, by a check the plan holds, or by the review.
criteria.evidence: docs/domain/domain-model.md:203-206 adds P-8 right after P-7 with the exact wording
